item.coloph: zhes rgya yis gdab nas rig 'dzin gyi slob dpon dran pa yab yum gyis gangs can bod dang bod chen gyi sa mtshams spu rgyal tshe lung dpal 'bar gdong du rgyas gdab ste sbas pa/ bdag 'dra rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal lam mi 'gyur tshe dbang gsang sngags grags pa can gyi sa pho 'brug gi lor spyan drangs te rim par gtan la phab pa'o//
